title: Professional Email Reactivation Renewal Amount: Calculation Sheet
content:
Billing calculation for the reactivation renewal of a suspended Professional Email subscription.

**The amount.** The reactivation renewal is the rounded renewal component plus every fee added to it, rounded half up to the cent. The renewal component is the renewed seats times the plan seat price times the renewal months, reduced by any rate that applies to it, rounded half up to the cent.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Plan seat price | the product's annual-prepaid seat price, its annual-commitment price, from the price schedule |
| Renewal months | the calendar months from the term start date to the term end date on the annual prepaid plan; 1 on the annual-billed-monthly plan, whose reactivation renewal is the new term's first monthly instalment, and 1 on the monthly plan |
| Renewed seats | the seat count on the subscription |
| Fees | no fee is added |

The billing plan, the term dates and the seat count are read from the subscription record.

## Worked examples (hypothetical prices and seat counts)

1. Annual prepaid plan on a 12-month term, 37 seats, a hypothetical annual-commitment seat price of 10.00: 37 times 10.00 times 12 is 4440.00, the renewal component; with no fee the reactivation renewal is 4440.00.
2. Monthly plan, 37 seats, the same hypothetical 10.00: 37 times 10.00 times 1 is 370.00.
3. The renewal component is rounded before anything is added: 9 seats at a hypothetical 1.255 for one month give 11.295, so the component is 11.30.
